description: This file provides Mac-specific API functions for the FreeType font rendering library, including functions to create font faces from Mac resources such as FOND, FSSpec, and FSRef, and to retrieve font file information on Mac OS.

methods.name: FT_New_Face_From_FOND
methods.description: Creates a new font face object from a FOND resource on Mac OS.

methods.name: FT_GetFile_From_Mac_Name
methods.description: Retrieves the FSSpec for a font given its Mac OS name.

methods.name: FT_GetFile_From_Mac_ATS_Name
methods.description: Retrieves the FSSpec for a font in the ATS framework by name.

methods.name: FT_GetFilePath_From_Mac_ATS_Name
methods.description: Returns the pathname and face index for a font handled by ATS framework.

methods.name: FT_New_Face_From_FSSpec
methods.description: Creates a new font face from an FSSpec to a font file.

methods.name: FT_New_Face_From_FSRef
methods.description: Creates a new font face from an FSRef to a font file.
